title: Why Humans Tell Stories
thumbnailPrompt: A diverse group of people are gathered around a crackling campfire at night, their faces illuminated by the warm glow. They are laughing and sharing stories, their expressions reflecting pure joy and connection. Capture the cinematic feel of a high-end documentary, using photorealistic rendering and dramatic lighting to evoke a sense of wonder and universal understanding. The focus should be on the shared experience of joy, transcending cultural differences.
infographicPrompts: A network diagram visualizing how laughter and joy spread through a social group. Nodes represent individuals, and connections between them glow brighter as joy is shared. Use a clean, modern style with high contrast to ensure readability. Emphasize the interconnectedness and positive feedback loop of shared joy.

A 3D cross-section of the human brain highlighting the regions activated during laughter and moments of joy. Different areas are color-coded to represent specific emotional responses. The style should be clean and scientific, suitable for overlaying text and explanations later. Focus on conveying the complex neurological basis of joy in a visually engaging way.

A conceptual flowchart illustrating the flow of joy from a single individual to a global community. Starting with a single spark of joy, it branches out to represent how positive emotions can ripple outwards, impacting relationships, communities, and ultimately, the world. Use a bright, uplifting color palette and a clean, modern design.
